impact_scope.description: The existing tangent-generation API changes how tangent groups with opposite or degenerate orientations are merged and changes the fallback orientation for isolated degenerate triangles; its signature and invocation protocol remain unchanged.

evidence: S0 already declares meshopt_generateTangentsMikkT with the same caller-facing parameters.
H0 calls meshlet construction, codec, and simplification APIs, but never calls meshopt_generateTangentsMikkT.
S1 retains the same meshopt_generateTangentsMikkT declaration and caller-facing parameters.
Unchanged H0 still never calls meshopt_generateTangentsMikkT, so the identical API exposure remains absent.

new_harness_obligation.description: The commit changes behavior inside an already-existing omitted API but adds no entry point, caller-supplied argument or buffer, configuration, lifecycle transition, or new way H0 must reach or control that API.
evidence: The public function signature is identical in S0 and S1.
The new groupsign allocation and propagation are internal and supplied automatically within meshopt_generateTangentsMikkT.
The changed degenerate-orientation result and group-merging algorithm require no new caller action relative to invoking the same API in S0.

reason: For the anchored meshopt_generateTangentsMikkT surface, H0 has the same direct-call exposure gap before and after. The production change alters internal processing and outputs for certain existing inputs without changing how the harness must invoke or control the API, so the gap is UNCHANGED and does not create a maintenance need.
